lines.en: I skim the low growth beneath the trees.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的绿边一闪一闪。
lines.en: Green-banded wings flash as I fly.

lines.zh: 我升到半空，风把我带走一段。
lines.en: I rise and the wind carries me a way.
I fly low over a clump of blue flowers.
My wings beat slowly, almost drifting.
I settle on a leaf to rest.
I lift off and climb.
I round a hanging vine.
I fly through the gaps in the light.
I skim the moss.
I bank to look for flowers.
I pass over your shoulder.
I hover a beat or two.
I glide down on the wind.
I pause on the bark.
I settle on a blue flower and sip.

lines.zh: 翅膀合起来，绿色的边露在外面。
lines.en: Wings closed, the green edges show.
I'm sunning myself.
The forest wind is light.
I spread my antennae.

lines.zh: 一只甲虫爬过树干，我没理。
lines.en: A beetle climbs the trunk; I pay no mind.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀上有细小的鳞。
lines.en: Fine scales cover my wings.
The wood is quiet.
I open and close my wings softly.
I look up at the canopy.
Dappled light moves across my wings.
I fly up to your height.

lines.zh: 你身上有草和木头的味道。
lines.en: You smell of grass and wood.

lines.zh: 我绕你的帽子转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle around your hat.
Your hand moves and I'm off.
I settle on a nearby flower.
Step aside; I need to sun my wings.
My green-skirted wings tilt as I look at you.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，但也不想靠近。
lines.en: I'm not afraid, but I'd rather not get closer.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩坏了几朵花。
lines.en: Your boots crushed a few flowers.
I drop, then recover.
I land on a leaf.
A small piece of wing is gone.
Each beat costs me.
A corner is torn; I can still flap.
I hide in a crack in the bark.
My wings... can they still beat?
Don't swat me — I'll fall apart.
The smell of blue flowers.

lines.zh: 你把花举起来，我看见了。
lines.en: You lift the flower; I see it.
I land and take one sip.
Sweet, and faint.
Don't pinch the stem.
I circle the flower in your hand.
I'd like to stay a while.
Your fingers are too close.
You spun me in a half turn.
A few scales shake loose.
I climb quickly.
I can't stop and hit the trunk.

lines.zh: 我翅下的绿裙，飘了一下。
lines.en: The green skirt under my wings swayed.
You're too big to bump into.
I retreat to a high branch.
At least I can still fly.

lines.zh: 林里有另一只绿裙男爵。
lines.en: Another green skirt baron in the wood.
We circle the same clump of flowers.
Its green bands are darker than mine.
Its wings brush mine.
Then we fly apart.
I'll lay eggs on the leaf.
I go back to the nectar.
The wind has softened.
I land and grip it.
This isn't a flower.
I try it with my proboscis.
I settle my feet.
I fly back to the flower.
I'll leave it be.
Nectar is stuck to my wings.

lines.zh: 这片叶子上的花，我先尝。
lines.en: I'll taste the blooms on this leaf first.
Something moves under the trees.
That shadow is too large.
I pause on the bark.
I close my wings tight.
Green against bark. Just right.
I creep along a short way.
Time to fly.
I slip into the leaves.
I hold on the branch.
The wind sways me.
It circles the tree.
I fly to the other side.
It hasn't followed.
I settle back.
The sun has shifted.
Safe now.
I beat my wings and dart in.
My force is like a puff of wind.
I bump its hand.
Then I'm away.
I can't fight anything.
All I can do is dodge.
I land on a high branch.
My wings are still trembling.

lines.zh: 我从叶背的卵里孵出来。
lines.en: I hatch from an egg on a leaf's underside.
My wings are wet; I wait.
The forest light is gold and green.
The trunks are tall.
I find a clump of blue flowers.
I land and take a sip.
Faint and good.
I fly deeper into the wood.
My wing edges curl and I drop.

lines.zh: 我摔在落叶里，翅膀摊着。
lines.en: I hit the leaf litter, wings spread.
My wings are soaked; I can't beat them.

lines.zh: 气浪把我吹得撞上树干。
lines.en: The blast throws me into a trunk.

lines.zh: 箭羽擦过，绿鳞落了几片。
lines.en: The fletching grazed me; green scales fell.
The light takes my bearings.
No nectar, and I can't gain height.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，风也托不住我。
lines.en: I fall, and the wind can't hold me.
